retained_evidence: OpenAI Chat gpt-4o-mini returned token logprobs that DSEx extracted into raw confidence and descriptive raw Brier/ECE metrics.
rejection_reasons: The 12 calibration evaluations were all correct, so the fit had no outcome class balance.
The fit used one histogram bin and therefore could only map every score to the same empirical rate.
Each of the 12 held-out source IDs was evaluated under both prompts behind distinct caller-namespaced evaluation IDs.
The reported post-calibration Brier score and ECE of zero are a deterministic consequence of mapping an all-correct fixture to 1.0, not evidence of learned calibration.
Prompt drift from repeated held-out sources is excluded because the current protocol requires each held-out source ID to be unique.

replacement_fixture.note: No fresh paid run was made because the prior model/fixture pairing was degenerate. A future run must produce mixed calibration outcomes and at least two supported confidence bins before learned calibration can be claimed.
